description: file-backed mmap (POSIX-gap list). Kernel Mmap syscall (7) now honours fd+offset: a MAP_PRIVATE file mapping is eagerly populated from the file via the VFS (kernel/src/syscall/mod.rs sys_mmap + populate_file_mapping; kernel/src/process/mod.rs write_mapped_region writes through the phys alias), writes stay private, the sub-page tail past EOF reads zero, the fd offset is preserved, and MAP_SHARED is a documented EOPNOTSUPP (no coherent write-back yet, not a silent private substitute). Stock musl mmap() already passes all six args, so userspace/ctests/musl_mmap.c needs no fork change. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_mmap_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 240 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: a MAP_PRIVATE file mapping reads back the file content and the sub-page tail past EOF is zero
mmap left the fd offset untouched (POSIX)
a write to a MAP_PRIVATE mapping stays private and never reaches the file
a page-aligned file offset maps the correct slice of the file
MAP_SHARED is refused with EOPNOTSUPP, not silently downgraded to a private mapping
